# Commands Used — Day 010

## Navigate to Project Directory

```bash
cd /root/code/fraud-detection/
```

---

## Initialize DVC

```bash
dvc init
```

---

## Verify Generated Files

```bash
ls -a
```

---

## Stage DVC Files

```bash
git add .dvc .dvcignore
```

---

## Commit DVC Initialization

```bash
git commit -m "Initialize DVC"
```

---

## Verify Git Status

```bash
git status
```

---

## Verify Commit History

```bash
git log --oneline
```
